If there's still no movement after 48 hours from label creation or no new scans after 48 hours from the last one, the shipment may need further review. In that case, I can look into your order directly if you share your email address along with either your order ID (starting with USA-) or your ZIP code.

My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?

When tracking shows delivered but the package hasn't been found, it's worth checking around your delivery address (front door, side door, back door, garage, mailroom, or other secure locations) and checking with household members, neighbors, or building staff. Sometimes the delivery scan posts before the package is actually retrieved, so allowing up to 24 to 48 hours can help in case it arrives shortly after the scan.
